_joint_limits_note: r1F it1: physical X5 joint limits (robot description; LESSONS.md #16 from classify/r0B_lean). cuRobo/URDF allow +-10 rad; out-of-range solutions are not followed (parent it6 dev07 alarm: 11 servo stalls, 107 actions, empty grasp). IK answers are wrapped into this range or re-solved (ik_limit_tries).
_r1F_it1_note: r1F it1 (fork of r0B_lean 0f3f2268): (1) physical joint limits on every IK answer; (2) alarm held across its depth (short axis) first at any tilt, width hold only as fallback; placed-clock check requires top 4.2 cm above the drawer top (upright 5.8 vs lying 2.5), a lying clock stops retries; slow contact descent for the alarm; (3) no drawer plan -> self-relay: put the clock down at a staging spot 0.38-0.46 m in front of the left base from which the drawer plan is IK-feasible; (4) figures wider than 12 cm (Hulk, survey extent ~16 cm; others <= 9 cm) are grasped across the narrow axis of their top 2.5 cm (head/hunched back) and hang from the grip, 8-action settle above the stand.
_r1F_it1_note2: probes B/G: re-orienting relay made the alarm upright on dev03 and dev06 (native 25 each); Hulk top grasp at top-2.5cm slipped off the head on lift (dev07) and has no IK pre-grasp near the base (dev05, falls back to the band grasp) -> top grasp 3.5 cm deep (fingers below the head/shoulder bulge).
_r1F_it2_note: it1 full DEV J=93.75 (100/100/50/75/50/50/50/75). it2: relay stage pick only across the clock depth (it1 dev02/04/05 stage width holds: shallow grip / lying drop); replan twice after a relay; wide-figure decision fixed from the first observation (it1 dev06 re-observed Iron-Man >12 cm -> wrong top grasp); carry/lift legs abort when an arm is >4 cm behind its piece (it1 dev03 ~150 actions pinned on the drawer); figurine carry detours along x first when the straight line passes within 3 cm of the drawer top footprint; plant window = other window (pot grasp 0/4: parent it6 dev02 x2, r1F it1 dev02 x2; cactus at 0.6h 2/2 on dev00).
_it4_flush_note: flush it4 (dev3-driven): pre-grasp back-off 0.10/0.14 -> 0.06 -> 0.03 m with an extra IK seed, alarm tilts +57/72; relay replans from fresh views and may relay twice; joint-space fallback to the planned pre-grasp when a Cartesian piece has no IK; stand fallback = head RGB-D light-grey flat patch (stand is ~1 mm high, depth alone cannot see it); clock half hidden by the home gripper -> raise arm and re-ground; figurine slow lift (1 cm), release 6 mm low with 5 mm steps, gradual open, slow back-out; figurine tol 1.5 -> 1.2 cm, 5 attempts (dev307: upright 1.8-3.1 cm off, not counted).
_r2F_it1_note: r2F it1 closed loop: semantic-outage waits; figurine lift-verify (3 cm slow lift, head-depth foot footprint empty?) -> put back + exclude height; finger-gap hold check; slow carry 0.05 rad/action with drop checks per leg; above-stand settle + in-hand head-depth foot correction (port of r0B it11) before lowering; retreat from actual release pose; figurine tol 1.2->2 cm (in-hand correction replaces destructive re-grasps on the stand).
_r2F_it3_note: r2F it3: Cartesian safe homing over the home TCP after figurine release (it1 dev309 swept the placed figure); bands <2 cm penalised +0.04 (it1 dev300 1.5 cm cactus stem slipped in carry; DEV dev00 success band is 2.5 cm); carry-dropped grasp heights excluded.
_it14_note: r2F it14: stand sits right against the drawer's right side; left-arm jaws closing along x put the palm housing (+-8.7 cm along closing) on/into the drawer (URDF FK offline: approach azimuth 30-110 deg -> hundreds of points inside the drawer box, 120-140 deg at tilt 50-80 -> 0). Figurine place yaw chosen so the place approach azimuth is ~130 deg (hand front-right of the figure), wrist turned in <=20 deg steps during the carry, whole-arm FK vs observed drawer box checked at turn end/above/place/retreat; min-hit fallback.
